name: Unigram-FOL
description: A parallel grammar-based declarative framework designed to generate synthetic first-order logic (FOL) reasoning problems in both natural language (simplified English) and formal logic representations. It evaluates logical reasoning in isolation, allowing for the procedural generation of highly complex 'logic haystacks' spanning up to thousands of clauses without introducing paradoxes.
typical_sota_score: 70% - 80% (Fine-tuned DeBERTa models outperform generalist LLMs like GPT-4)
reputation: Highly respected for isolating pure logical deduction from the confounding artifacts found in human-authored text datasets. It has been used to uncover severe limitations in long-context logic capabilities of modern LLMs.
notes: Generates expressions with controllable semantic constraints up to 2048 clauses (≈ 25k tokens). Tests pure deductive reasoning using external FOL solvers as the ground-truth validators.
